_source.description: Current heads of state for UN member states and select entities
_source.origin: CIA World Factbook — Chiefs of State and Cabinet Members (https://www.cia.gov/the-world-factbook/); capital coordinates from GeoNames (https://www.geonames.org/)
_source.license: Public domain (CIA World Factbook); CC-BY-4.0 (GeoNames coordinates)
_source.notes: Leadership data is time-sensitive — reflects status as of early 2025. For monarchies and Commonwealth realms, the head of state is the monarch. Coordinates are for the capital city, not personal residence.

located.name: Abdelmadjid Tebboune
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister. Won 2019 presidential election during political transition following Bouteflika era. Re-elected in 2024.

located.name: João Lourenço
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Defense Minister. Succeeded José Eduardo dos Santos as MPLA leader and president. Re-elected 2022.

located.name: Patrice Talon
located.title: President
located.bio: Businessman turned politician. Re-elected in 2021 amid opposition boycott.

located.name: Duma Boko
located.title: President
located.bio: Opposition leader who won October 2024 elections, ending nearly six decades of BDP rule.

located.name: Ibrahim Traoré
located.title: Transitional President
located.bio: Army captain who seized power in September 2022 coup. Leads military transitional government.

located.name: Évariste Ndayishimiye
located.title: President
located.bio: Former army general. Won 2020 election as ruling party candidate.

located.name: José Maria Neves
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister (2001–2016). Elected president in October 2021.

located.name: Paul Biya
located.title: President
located.bio: One of the world's longest-serving heads of state. In power since 1982. Former Prime Minister under Ahmadou Ahidjo.

located.name: Faustin-Archange Touadéra
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister. Won 2016 election after transitional period. Re-elected 2020.

located.name: Mahamat Idriss Déby
located.title: President
located.bio: Son of former President Idriss Déby. Assumed power via Transitional Military Council after his father's death. Won 2024 presidential election.

located.name: Azali Assoumani
located.title: President
located.bio: Former army officer. Previously president 1999–2006. Returned to power in 2016 election. Extended term via 2018 referendum.

located.name: Denis Sassou Nguesso
located.title: President
located.bio: One of Africa's longest-serving leaders. First tenure 1979–1992, returned to power in 1997 civil war. Re-elected multiple times.

located.name: Félix Tshisekedi
located.title: President
located.bio: Son of opposition leader Étienne Tshisekedi. Won 2018 election — first peaceful transfer of power in DRC history. Re-elected 2023.

located.name: Alassane Ouattara
located.title: President
located.bio: Former IMF Deputy Managing Director. Won disputed 2010 election, took office after political crisis. Re-elected 2015, 2020.

located.name: Ismaïl Omar Guelleh
located.title: President
located.bio: Nephew of independence leader Hassan Gouled Aptidon. In office since 1999. Re-elected 2005, 2011, 2016, 2021.

located.name: Abdel Fattah el-Sisi
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Defense Minister. Led 2013 military removal of President Morsi. Elected president 2014. Re-elected 2018, 2024.

located.name: Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo
located.title: President
located.bio: World's longest-serving current head of state. Seized power in 1979 coup from his uncle. Re-elected in successive elections.

located.name: Isaias Afwerki
located.title: President
located.bio: Independence leader. Has served as president since Eritrean independence in 1993. No elections held since.

located.name: King Mswati III
located.title: King
located.bio: Africa's last absolute monarch. Crowned in 1986 at age 18. Rules without political parties.

located.name: Taye Atske Selassie
located.title: President
located.bio: Career diplomat. Appointed president (largely ceremonial role) by parliament in October 2024, succeeding Sahle-Work Zewde.

located.name: Brice Oligui Nguema
located.title: Transitional President
located.bio: Former head of Republican Guard. Led August 2023 coup that ended the Bongo family's 55-year rule.

located.name: Adama Barrow
located.title: President
located.bio: Real estate developer who defeated longtime ruler Yahya Jammeh in 2016 election. Re-elected 2021.

located.name: John Mahama
located.title: President
located.bio: Former President (2012–2017). Won December 2024 election in a political comeback, defeating the ruling NPP.

located.name: Mamadi Doumbouya
located.title: Transitional President
located.bio: Former French Foreign Legion officer. Led September 2021 coup against Alpha Condé.

located.name: Umaro Sissoco Embaló
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister. Won 2019 presidential runoff election.

located.name: William Ruto
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Deputy President under Uhuru Kenyatta. Won 2022 presidential election.

located.name: King Letsie III
located.title: King
located.bio: Constitutional monarch. Second reign began 1996 after father King Moshoeshoe II's death. Ceremonial role.

located.name: Joseph Boakai
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Vice President (2006–2018). Won 2023 election, defeating incumbent George Weah.

located.name: Mohamed al-Menfi
located.title: Chairman, Presidential Council
located.bio: Former diplomat. Selected as head of Presidential Council through UN-brokered Libyan Political Dialogue Forum.

located.name: Andry Rajoelina
located.title: President
located.bio: Former mayor of Antananarivo. Led 2009 political crisis. Won 2018 election. Re-elected 2023.

located.name: Lazarus Chakwera
located.title: President
located.bio: Former church leader. Won 2020 court-ordered re-run election after 2019 results were annulled.

located.name: Assimi Goïta
located.title: Transitional President
located.bio: Army colonel who led August 2020 coup and May 2021 second takeover. Heads military transitional government.

located.name: Mohamed Ould Ghazouani
located.title: President
located.bio: Former army chief and Defense Minister. Won 2019 presidential election. Re-elected 2024.

located.name: Prithvirajsing Roopun
located.title: President
located.bio: Ceremonial president. Former lawyer and parliamentarian. Appointed by parliament.

located.name: King Mohammed VI
located.title: King
located.bio: Ascended to throne in 1999 upon death of his father King Hassan II. Oversaw 2011 constitutional reforms.

located.name: Daniel Chapo
located.title: President
located.bio: Former provincial governor. Won October 2024 presidential election as ruling FRELIMO party candidate.

located.name: Netumbo Nandi-Ndaitwah
located.title: President
located.bio: First female president of Namibia. Former Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Affairs Minister. Won November 2024 election.

located.name: Abdourahamane Tchiani
located.title: Chairman, National Council for the Safeguard of the Homeland
located.bio: Former head of Presidential Guard. Led July 2023 coup against President Bazoum.

located.name: Bola Tinubu
located.title: President
located.bio: Former governor of Lagos State. Won 2023 presidential election. Known as political kingmaker.

located.name: Paul Kagame
located.title: President
located.bio: Led RPF forces that ended the 1994 genocide. Vice President 1994–2000, President since 2000. Re-elected 2003, 2010, 2017, 2024.

located.name: Carlos Vila Nova
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Infrastructure Minister. Won 2021 presidential runoff election.

located.name: Bassirou Diomaye Faye
located.title: President
located.bio: Former tax inspector. Youngest elected president in Senegal's history. Won March 2024 election weeks after release from detention.

located.name: Wavel Ramkalawan
located.title: President
located.bio: Anglican priest turned politician. Won 2020 election, ending over two decades of SPPF/United Seychelles rule.

located.name: Julius Maada Bio
located.title: President
located.bio: Former military leader (briefly headed junta in 1996). Won 2018 election democratically. Re-elected 2023.

located.name: Hassan Sheikh Mohamud
located.title: President
located.bio: Academic and civil society activist. Previously president 2012–2017. Elected again by parliament in May 2022.

located.name: Cyril Ramaphosa
located.title: President
located.bio: Anti-apartheid activist and businessman. Deputy President under Zuma. Became president after Zuma resignation. Leads ANC coalition government after 2024 elections.

located.name: Salva Kiir Mayardit
located.title: President
located.bio: Independence leader. President since South Sudan's independence in 2011. Former SPLA military commander.

located.name: Abdel Fattah al-Burhan
located.title: Chairman, Sovereignty Council
located.bio: Army general. Chairs the Sovereignty Council since 2019 transitional period. Led October 2021 military takeover.

located.name: Samia Suluhu Hassan
located.title: President
located.bio: First female president of Tanzania. Succeeded John Magufuli after his death. Former Vice President.

located.name: Faure Gnassingbé
located.title: President
located.bio: Son of longtime ruler Gnassingbé Eyadéma. Assumed power in 2005 after father's death. Re-elected 2010, 2015, 2020.

located.name: Kais Saied
located.title: President
located.bio: Constitutional law professor. Won 2019 election as independent outsider. Assumed expanded powers in 2021. Re-elected 2024.

located.name: Yoweri Museveni
located.title: President
located.bio: Former guerrilla leader. In power since 1986 after leading NRA insurgency. One of Africa's longest-serving leaders.

located.name: Hakainde Hichilema
located.title: President
located.bio: Businessman. Won 2021 election in a landslide on his sixth presidential attempt, defeating incumbent Lungu.

located.name: Emmerson Mnangagwa
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Vice President. Took power after November 2017 military intervention that removed Robert Mugabe. Won 2018 and 2023 elections.

located.name: Javier Milei
located.title: President
located.bio: Libertarian economist and former TV commentator. Won 2023 election on anti-establishment platform. Implementing radical free-market reforms.

located.name: Sandra Mason
located.title: President
located.bio: First president of Barbados after the country became a republic in November 2021, removing the British monarch as head of state.

located.name: Luis Arce
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Economy Minister under Evo Morales. Won 2020 election. Has faced political tensions with Morales faction of MAS.

located.name: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
located.title: President
located.bio: Third term as president (previously 2003–2010). Former union leader. Won narrow 2022 runoff against Bolsonaro.

located.name: King Charles III
located.title: King (via Governor-General)
located.bio: King of Canada as a Commonwealth realm. Represented by Governor-General Mary Simon, the first Indigenous person in the role.

located.name: Gabriel Boric
located.title: President
located.bio: Former student protest leader. Youngest president in Chilean history at 36. Won 2021 runoff election.

located.name: Gustavo Petro
located.title: President
located.bio: First left-wing president in Colombian history. Former guerrilla member (M-19), senator, and mayor of Bogotá.

located.name: Rodrigo Chaves Robles
located.title: President
located.bio: Former World Bank economist. Won 2022 election as political outsider.

located.name: Miguel Díaz-Canel
located.title: President
located.bio: First non-Castro head of state since the 1959 revolution. Rose through party ranks as electronics engineer and provincial leader.

located.name: Luis Abinader
located.title: President
located.bio: Businessman and economist. Won 2020 election. Re-elected in 2024 with over 57% of the vote.

located.name: Daniel Noboa
located.title: President
located.bio: Son of banana magnate Álvaro Noboa. At 35, youngest president in Ecuadorian history. Won 2023 snap election.

located.name: Nayib Bukele
located.title: President
located.bio: Former mayor of San Salvador. Known for aggressive anti-gang security policies and Bitcoin adoption. Re-elected 2024 despite constitutional one-term limit.

located.name: Bernardo Arévalo
located.title: President
located.bio: Sociologist and diplomat. Son of former President Juan José Arévalo. Won 2023 election on anti-corruption platform despite legal challenges.

located.name: Irfaan Ali
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Housing Minister. Won contentious 2020 election after months-long vote counting dispute. Overseeing oil boom.

located.name: Xiomara Castro
located.title: President
located.bio: First female president of Honduras. Wife of deposed President Manuel Zelaya. Won 2021 election in landslide.

located.name: Claudia Sheinbaum
located.title: President
located.bio: First female president of Mexico. Former Head of Government of Mexico City. Environmental engineer and IPCC contributor. Won June 2024 election in landslide.

located.name: Daniel Ortega
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Sandinista revolutionary leader and president (1985–1990). Returned to power in 2007. Re-elected 2011, 2016, 2021.

located.name: José Raúl Mulino
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Security Minister. Won May 2024 election as substitute candidate after leading candidate Ricardo Martinelli was barred.

located.name: Santiago Peña
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Finance Minister and central bank economist. Won 2023 election, maintaining Colorado Party's long dominance.

located.name: Dina Boluarte
located.title: President
located.bio: First female president of Peru. Former Vice President who assumed office after Pedro Castillo's removal following his attempted self-coup.

located.name: Chan Santokhi
located.title: President
located.bio: Former police commissioner and Justice Minister. Won 2020 election, defeating incumbent Desi Bouterse.

located.name: Christine Kangaloo
located.title: President
located.bio: First female president of Trinidad and Tobago. Former Senate President. Elected by electoral college in 2023.

located.name: Donald Trump
located.title: President
located.bio: 47th President. Previously 45th President (2017–2021). Businessman and media personality. Won 2024 election for non-consecutive second term.

located.name: Yamandú Orsi
located.title: President
located.bio: Former governor of Canelones department. Won November 2024 presidential runoff, returning Frente Amplio to power.

located.name: Nicolás Maduro
located.title: President
located.bio: Successor to Hugo Chávez. Former bus driver and union leader. Presidency contested internationally after disputed 2018 and 2024 elections.

located.name: Hibatullah Akhundzada
located.title: Supreme Leader
located.bio: Islamic scholar. Became Taliban Supreme Leader in 2016 after predecessor killed by drone strike. De facto head of state since Taliban takeover in August 2021.

located.name: Vahagn Khachaturyan
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Minister of High-Tech Industry. Elected by parliament as president (largely ceremonial role) in 2022.

located.name: Ilham Aliyev
located.title: President
located.bio: Son of former President Heydar Aliyev. In power since 2003. Oversaw 2020 and 2023 military operations reclaiming Karabakh.

located.name: King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa
located.title: King
located.bio: Emir since 1999, became King when Bahrain changed to a kingdom in 2002. Oversaw 2001 political reforms.

located.name: Muhammad Yunus
located.title: Chief Adviser (Interim Head of Government)
located.bio: Nobel Peace Prize laureate (2006) and founder of Grameen Bank. Appointed to lead interim government after Sheikh Hasina's ouster in August 2024 student uprising.

located.name: King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck
located.title: King
located.bio: Fifth Druk Gyalpo (Dragon King). Educated at Oxford. Crowned in 2008. Oversaw transition to constitutional monarchy.

located.name: Sultan Hassanal Bolkiah
located.title: Sultan
located.bio: One of the world's longest-reigning monarchs. Also serves as Prime Minister, Defense Minister, and Finance Minister.

located.name: King Norodom Sihamoni
located.title: King
located.bio: Selected by Royal Council of the Throne after his father Norodom Sihanouk's abdication. Former UNESCO ambassador and classical dancer.

located.name: Xi Jinping
located.title: President
located.bio: Also General Secretary of the CCP and Chairman of the Central Military Commission. Consolidated power with removal of presidential term limits in 2018. Considered China's most powerful leader since Mao.

located.name: Nikos Christodoulides
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Foreign Minister. Won 2023 election as independent candidate with cross-party support.

located.name: Mikheil Kavelashvili
located.title: President
located.bio: Former professional football player. Elected by electoral college in December 2024 amid protests and opposition boycott.

located.name: Droupadi Murmu
located.title: President
located.bio: First president from a tribal community and second female president of India. Former governor of Jharkhand.

located.name: Prabowo Subianto
located.title: President
located.bio: Former army general and son-in-law of Suharto. Won February 2024 election on his third attempt at the presidency.

located.name: Masoud Pezeshkian
located.title: President
located.bio: Heart surgeon and former Health Minister. Won July 2024 snap election after President Raisi's death in helicopter crash. Considered a moderate reformist.

located.name: Abdul Latif Rashid
located.title: President
located.bio: Kurdish engineer and former Water Resources Minister. Elected president by parliament in October 2022.

located.name: Isaac Herzog
located.title: President
located.bio: Son of former President Chaim Herzog. Former Labor Party leader and opposition head. Serves in largely ceremonial role.

located.name: Emperor Naruhito
located.title: Emperor
located.bio: 126th Emperor of Japan. Ascended the Chrysanthemum Throne upon father Akihito's historic abdication. Inaugurated the Reiwa era.

located.name: King Abdullah II
located.title: King
located.bio: Hashemite monarch. Sandhurst-educated military officer. Succeeded father King Hussein. Key Western ally in Middle East.

located.name: Kassym-Jomart Tokayev
located.title: President
located.bio: Career diplomat. Successor to Nursultan Nazarbayev. Consolidated power after January 2022 unrest. Re-elected 2022.

located.name: Kim Jong-un
located.title: Supreme Leader
located.bio: Third-generation leader of DPRK dynasty. Son of Kim Jong-il, grandson of Kim Il-sung. Holds multiple supreme titles. Expanded nuclear weapons program.

located.name: Emir Mishal Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah
located.title: Emir
located.bio: Succeeded Emir Nawaf after his death. Former Crown Prince and Deputy Commander of the National Guard.

located.name: Sadyr Japarov
located.title: President
located.bio: Former MP freed from prison during October 2020 political crisis. Won January 2021 snap presidential election.

located.name: Thongloun Sisoulith
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister. Became President and party General Secretary. Leads the one-party communist state.

located.name: Joseph Aoun
located.title: President
located.bio: Former commander of the Lebanese Armed Forces. Elected president by parliament in January 2025, ending over two years of presidential vacancy.

located.name: Sultan Ibrahim
located.title: Yang di-Pertuan Agong (King)
located.bio: Sultan of Johor. Elected as 17th Yang di-Pertuan Agong under Malaysia's rotational monarchy system.

located.name: Mohamed Muizzu
located.title: President
located.bio: Former mayor of Malé and Housing Minister. Won 2023 election on pro-sovereignty, India Out platform.

located.name: Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister. Won 2021 presidential election. Overseeing Mongolia's mining-driven economic development.

located.name: Min Aung Hlaing
located.title: Chairman, State Administration Council
located.bio: Senior General who led February 2021 coup against elected government of Aung San Suu Kyi. Faces armed resistance from multiple fronts.

located.name: Ram Chandra Poudel
located.title: President
located.bio: Veteran politician and former Speaker of Parliament. Elected to largely ceremonial presidency in 2023.

located.name: Sultan Haitham bin Tariq
located.title: Sultan
located.bio: Cousin of Sultan Qaboos. Selected as successor per sealed envelope mechanism upon Qaboos's death. Former Heritage and Culture Minister.

located.name: Asif Ali Zardari
located.title: President
located.bio: Widower of Benazir Bhutto. Second term as president (first 2008–2013). Elected by parliament in March 2024.

located.name: Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
located.title: President
located.bio: Son of former dictator Ferdinand Marcos Sr. Won 2022 election by large margin. Also known as Bongbong.

located.name: Emir Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani
located.title: Emir
located.bio: Assumed power after father Sheikh Hamad's abdication. Oversaw 2022 FIFA World Cup. Plays outsized diplomatic role for Qatar's size.

located.name: King Salman bin Abdulaziz
located.title: King and Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques
located.bio: Sixth king of Saudi Arabia. Day-to-day governance largely handled by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman (MBS), who leads Vision 2030 reforms.

located.name: Tharman Shanmugaratnam
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Senior Minister and Deputy Prime Minister. Won 2023 presidential election with 70.4% of the vote.

located.name: Yoon Suk-yeol
located.title: President (suspended)
located.bio: Former Prosecutor General. Won 2022 election. Impeached by National Assembly in December 2024 after brief martial law declaration. Presidential powers suspended pending Constitutional Court ruling.

located.name: Anura Kumara Dissanayake
located.title: President
located.bio: Marxist-leaning leader of the NPP coalition. Won September 2024 snap presidential election amid ongoing economic recovery from 2022 crisis.

located.name: Ahmad al-Sharaa
located.title: De facto Head of State
located.bio: Former jihadist commander (previously known as Abu Mohammed al-Julani). Led rebel offensive that toppled Assad regime in December 2024. Heading transitional governance.

located.name: Emomali Rahmon
located.title: President
located.bio: In power since 1992 (as chairman, then president from 1994). One of Central Asia's longest-serving leaders. Holds title 'Founder of Peace and National Unity.'

located.name: King Maha Vajiralongkorn
located.title: King
located.bio: Rama X of the Chakri dynasty. Succeeded his father King Bhumibol Adulyadej, the world's longest-reigning monarch at the time.

located.name: José Ramos-Horta
located.title: President
located.bio: Nobel Peace Prize laureate (1996). Independence leader. Previously president 2007–2012. Returned to presidency in 2022.

located.name: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister (2003–2014). Transitioned Turkey to presidential system via 2017 referendum. Re-elected 2018, 2023. Dominant figure in Turkish politics for two decades.

located.name: Serdar Berdimuhamedow
located.title: President
located.bio: Son of former President Gurbanguly Berdimuhamedow. Won 2022 election with reported 73% of the vote. Father retains influence as National Leader.

located.name: Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
located.title: President
located.bio: Known as MBZ. Ruler of Abu Dhabi. Elected president by Federal Supreme Council upon death of Sheikh Khalifa. Considered the architect of UAE's modern foreign policy.

located.name: Shavkat Mirziyoyev
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister. Succeeded Islam Karimov. Has pursued economic liberalization and regional diplomatic opening. Re-elected 2023.

located.name: Lương Cường
located.title: President
located.bio: Senior military-political figure. Became president in October 2024, the fourth person to hold the position in two years amid the party's anti-corruption campaign.

located.name: Rashad al-Alimi
located.title: Chairman, Presidential Leadership Council
located.bio: Heads the internationally recognized government's Presidential Leadership Council formed in 2022 after Hadi stepped down. Much of northern Yemen controlled by Houthi forces.

located.name: Bajram Begaj
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Chief of the General Staff of the Albanian Armed Forces. Elected president by parliament in 2022. Ceremonial role.

located.name: Emmanuel Macron
located.title: Co-Prince (also: President of France)
located.bio: As President of France, serves as one of two co-princes of Andorra (the other being the Bishop of Urgell). Unique shared-sovereignty arrangement dating to 1278.

located.name: Alexander Van der Bellen
located.title: President
located.bio: Former economics professor and Green Party leader. Won 2016 presidential election. Re-elected 2022.

located.name: Alexander Lukashenko
located.title: President
located.bio: Europe's longest-serving current leader. Former collective farm director. In power since 1994. 2020 election widely considered fraudulent, triggering mass protests.

located.name: King Philippe
located.title: King
located.bio: Succeeded his father King Albert II who abdicated. Holds ceremonial role as head of the Belgian federal state.

located.name: Rumen Radev
located.title: President
located.bio: Former air force commander. Won 2016 presidential election. Re-elected 2021.

located.name: Zoran Milanović
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister (2011–2016). Won 2019 presidential election. Re-elected 2024.

located.name: Petr Pavel
located.title: President
located.bio: Retired army general. Former Chairman of the NATO Military Committee (2015–2018). Won 2023 presidential election.

located.name: King Frederik X
located.title: King
located.bio: Succeeded his mother Queen Margrethe II upon her historic abdication in January 2024 after 52 years on the throne.

located.name: Alar Karis
located.title: President
located.bio: Molecular biologist and former Auditor General. Elected by parliament in 2021. Ceremonial role.

located.name: Alexander Stubb
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister (2014–2015). Won February 2024 presidential election. Has led Finland's foreign policy as newest NATO member.

located.name: Emmanuel Macron
located.title: President
located.bio: Former investment banker and Economy Minister. Youngest president in French history at 39. Re-elected 2022. Faces challenges from fragmented parliament after 2024 snap elections.

located.name: Frank-Walter Steinmeier
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Foreign Minister. Elected president (ceremonial role) in 2017. Re-elected 2022.

located.name: Katerina Sakellaropoulou
located.title: President
located.bio: First female president of Greece. Former president of the Council of State (highest administrative court). Ceremonial role.

located.name: Tamás Sulyok
located.title: President
located.bio: Former president of the Constitutional Court. Elected by parliament in February 2024 after Katalin Novák's resignation over a pardon scandal.

located.name: Halla Tómasdóttir
located.title: President
located.bio: Businesswoman and former CEO. Won June 2024 presidential election, succeeding Guðni Th. Jóhannesson. Second female president.

located.name: Michael D. Higgins
located.title: President
located.bio: Poet, academic, and human rights advocate. Longest-serving current Irish president. Re-elected 2018 for second and final term ending 2025.

located.name: Sergio Mattarella
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Constitutional Court justice. Re-elected in 2022 after initially declining, due to parliamentary deadlock.

located.name: Vjosa Osmani
located.title: President
located.bio: Former acting president and parliament speaker. Elected president by parliament in April 2021.

located.name: Edgars Rinkēvičs
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Foreign Minister (2011–2023). Elected by parliament. First openly gay head of state in the EU.

located.name: Prince Hans-Adam II
located.title: Prince
located.bio: Reigning prince. Expanded princely powers via 2003 referendum. Day-to-day governance handled by Hereditary Prince Alois as regent since 2004.

located.name: Gitanas Nausėda
located.title: President
located.bio: Economist and former bank adviser. Won 2019 election. Re-elected 2024. Prominent voice on European security and Ukraine support.

located.name: Grand Duke Henri
located.title: Grand Duke
located.bio: Succeeded his father Grand Duke Jean who abdicated. Constitutional monarch of the EU's wealthiest country per capita.

located.name: Myriam Spiteri Debono
located.title: President
located.bio: Former judge and former Speaker of the House of Representatives. First female president of Malta. Elected by parliament in 2024.

located.name: Maia Sandu
located.title: President
located.bio: Former World Bank adviser and Prime Minister. First female president of Moldova. Pro-EU reformer. Re-elected October 2024.

located.name: Prince Albert II
located.title: Sovereign Prince
located.bio: Son of Prince Rainier III and Grace Kelly. Five-time Olympian (bobsled). Heads one of the world's smallest sovereign states.

located.name: Jakov Milatović
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Finance Minister. Youngest president in Montenegrin history. Defeated longtime leader Milo Đukanović in 2023 election.

located.name: King Willem-Alexander
located.title: King
located.bio: Succeeded his mother Queen Beatrix who abdicated. Trained commercial pilot. Popular constitutional monarch.

located.name: Gordana Siljanovska-Davkova
located.title: President
located.bio: Constitutional law professor. First female president of North Macedonia. Won May 2024 presidential election.

located.name: King Harald V
located.title: King
located.bio: Ascended the throne upon death of father King Olav V. First king born in Norway in 567 years. Popular constitutional monarch.

located.name: Andrzej Duda
located.title: President
located.bio: Former MEP. Won 2015 election. Re-elected narrowly in 2020. Term ends 2025.

located.name: Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa
located.title: President
located.bio: Constitutional law professor and former TV commentator. Won 2016 election. Re-elected 2021. Known for accessible public style.

located.name: Klaus Iohannis
located.title: President
located.bio: Former mayor of Sibiu and ethnic German. Two terms. Remained in office after December 2024 presidential election was annulled by Constitutional Court.

located.name: Vladimir Putin
located.title: President
located.bio: Former KGB officer and FSB director. President 2000–2008, PM 2008–2012, president again from 2012. Fifth term began 2024. Launched full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

located.name: Aleksandar Vučić
located.title: President
located.bio: Former PM and Information Minister. Dominant figure in Serbian politics. Re-elected 2022. Balances EU accession path with Russia ties.

located.name: Peter Pellegrini
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Prime Minister (2018–2020). Won April 2024 presidential election. Close political ally of PM Robert Fico.

located.name: Nataša Pirc Musar
located.title: President
located.bio: First female president of Slovenia. Former Information Commissioner and data privacy lawyer.

located.name: King Felipe VI
located.title: King
located.bio: Succeeded his father King Juan Carlos I who abdicated. Georgetown-educated. Has worked to restore monarchy's reputation.

located.name: King Carl XVI Gustaf
located.title: King
located.bio: Europe's longest-reigning current monarch. Ascended throne at age 27. Purely ceremonial role under Swedish constitution.

located.name: Karin Keller-Sutter
located.title: President of the Confederation (2025)
located.bio: Annual rotating presidency from the seven-member Federal Council. Former cantonal councillor of St. Gallen. Member of Federal Council since 2019.

located.name: Volodymyr Zelenskyy
located.title: President
located.bio: Former comedian and actor. Won 2019 election in landslide. Became wartime leader after Russia's 2022 full-scale invasion. International symbol of Ukrainian resistance.

located.name: King Charles III
located.title: King
located.bio: Ascended throne upon death of Queen Elizabeth II after being the longest-serving heir apparent in British history. King of 14 other Commonwealth realms.

located.name: Pope Leo XIV
located.title: Sovereign of Vatican City State
located.bio: Born Robert Francis Prevost. American-born Augustinian friar. Former Prefect of the Dicastery for Bishops. Elected pope in May 2025 following death of Pope Francis.

located.name: King Charles III
located.title: King (via Governor-General)
located.bio: Head of state as King of Australia. Represented locally by Governor-General Sam Mostyn, who took office in July 2024.

located.name: Ratu Wiliame Katonivere
located.title: President
located.bio: Paramount chief. Appointed by parliament as ceremonial president.

located.name: Taneti Maamau
located.title: President
located.bio: Former educator. Won 2016 election. Re-elected 2020. Shifted Kiribati's diplomatic recognition from Taiwan to China.

located.name: Hilda Heine
located.title: President
located.bio: Second term as president (first 2016–2020 — first female head of state in any Pacific island nation). Returned to power in January 2024.

located.name: Wesley Simina
located.title: President
located.bio: Former senator from Chuuk state. Elected president by congress in May 2023.

located.name: David Adeang
located.title: President
located.bio: Long-serving parliamentarian and former Finance Minister. Elected president by parliament in October 2023.

located.name: King Charles III
located.title: King (via Governor-General)
located.bio: Head of state as King of New Zealand. Represented locally by Governor-General Dame Cindy Kiro.

located.name: Surangel Whipps Jr.
located.title: President
located.bio: Businessman. Won 2020 presidential election. Close US ally in Compact of Free Association.

located.name: King Charles III
located.title: King (via Governor-General)
located.bio: Head of state as King of Papua New Guinea. PNG is a Commonwealth realm with a Governor-General as the King's representative.

located.name: Tuimalealiifano Va'aletoa Sualauvi II
located.title: O le Ao o le Malo (Head of State)
located.bio: Holds the title of Tui Atua, one of Samoa's highest traditional chiefly titles. Elected by parliament for five-year term.

located.name: King Tupou VI
located.title: King
located.bio: Succeeded his brother King George Tupou V. Educated in Australia and the US. Tongan monarchy has evolved toward greater democracy.

located.name: Nikenike Vurobaravu
located.title: President
located.bio: Elected by electoral college. Ceremonial head of state of the Pacific island nation.

located.bio: Head of state of this Caribbean Commonwealth realm. Represented by a Governor-General.

located.name: Sylvanie Burton

located.bio: First female president of Dominica. Former permanent secretary. Elected by parliament in 2023.

located.name: Mahmoud Abbas
located.title: President
located.bio: Also known as Abu Mazen. Elected in 2005 for what was to be a four-year term. Remains in office with no subsequent election. Authority limited amid Israeli occupation and Hamas control of Gaza.

located.name: Lai Ching-te
located.title: President
located.bio: Former Vice President and Premier. Won January 2024 election, continuing DPP's hold on the presidency. Advocate for Taiwan's distinct identity.
